```yaml
name: PyInstaller macOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-macos:
    name: Build macOS Apple Silicon App
    runs-on: macos-14 # Apple Silicon runner

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          architecture: 'arm64'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller pyserial
          # Install any other project-specific dependencies if requirements.txt exists
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Convert icon to ICNS
        run: |
          # Ensure icon.png exists in the root or expected location
          if [ ! -f icon.png ]; then
            echo "Warning: icon.png not found, skipping ICNS conversion."
          else
            mkdir -p icon.iconset
            sips -z 16 16 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_16x16.png
            sips -z 32 32 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_16x16@2x.png
            sips -z 32 32 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_32x32.png
            sips -z 64 64 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_32x32@2x.png
            sips -z 128 128 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_128x128.png
            sips -z 256 256 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_128x128@2x.png
            sips -z 256 256 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_256x256.png
            sips -z 512 512 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_256x256@2x.png
            sips -z 512 512 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_512x512.png
            sips -z 1024 1024 icon.png --out icon.iconset/icon_512x512@2x.png
            iconutil -c icns icon.iconset
            rm -rf icon.iconset
          fi

      - name: Build with PyInstaller
        run: |
          # Use the spec file if it exists, otherwise build directly
          if [ -f obi-macos.spec ]; then
            pyinstaller obi-macos.spec
          else
            # Fallback build command if spec file is missing during development
            pyinstaller --name "OpenBatteryInformation" \
                        --windowed \
                        --icon=icon.icns \
                        --clean \
                        main.py # Replace main.py with your actual entry point
          fi

      - name: Create DMG
        run: |
          # Install create-dmg if not available
          brew install create-dmg || true
          
          APP_NAME="OpenBatteryInformation"
          DMG_NAME="${APP_NAME}-macOS-arm64.dmg"
          
          # Create DMG from the app bundle in dist/
          if [ -d "dist/${APP_NAME}.app" ]; then
            create-dmg \
              --volname "${APP_NAME}" \
              --window-pos 200 120 \
              --window-size 800 400 \
              --icon-size 100 \
              --icon "${APP_NAME}.app" 200 190 \
              --app-drop-link 600 185 \
              "${DMG_NAME}" \
              "dist/${APP_NAME}.app"
          else
            echo "Error: App bundle not found in dist/"
            ls -la dist/
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload DMG Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: OpenBatteryInformation-macOS-arm64
          path: "*.dmg"
          retention-days: 5
```
